invariants.name: compositor_steady_no_uiworld_mutations
invariants.note: After compositor start, a present tick must not mutate UiWorld. Missing stays not-evaluable.

invariants.name: compositor_steady_no_layout
invariants.note: Compositor-only opacity must not run LayoutSystem.

invariants.name: compositor_steady_no_style
invariants.note: Compositor-only opacity must not run StyleSystem.

invariants.name: compositor_steady_no_reextract
invariants.note: No scene/layer topology change on a timestamp frame.

invariants.name: compositor_steady_no_cpu_presentation_sample
invariants.note: No input/query on this frame. Hit-test may sample; this gate is present-only.

invariants.name: compositor_steady_sparse_deadlines
invariants.note: Keep the #8 sparse deadline contract. Compositor mid-duration ticks scan 0.

invariants.name: compositor_steady_sparse_considered
invariants.note: Keep animations_considered. A compositor mid-duration tick considers 0.

notes: Issue #87 §13 compositor-only steady frame. Work counters are the gate; steady_ms is a host observation. GPU descriptor upload is omitted (no encode/submit). Not #8 weekly DoD.
